result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows an obviously duplicated restaurant card and several horizontally scrolling items are clipped at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side-by-side in 'Fastest near you' with the same image, 15–25 min time, and €0.90 delivery fee, suggesting duplicated or incorrectly rendered data.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant results and verify the list adapter/data source is not binding the same item twice.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is cut off at the right edge and its title is truncated as 'Smash Bros Bu…', making the entry feel broken.
issues.suggestion: Add clear horizontal-scroll affordance, edge fade, or adjust card widths so partially visible items look intentional.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped after 'Healthy' with the next chip only barely visible, so users may not realize more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Increase peek width of the off-screen chip or add a gradient/arrow to indicate horizontal scrolling.
